Name: Vanilla Pepper Rex Barn Dinosaur
Author: BucketListMod
Description:
If it ever irritated you that you couldn't put a Dinosaur Egg in an Ostrich Incubator, this mod is for you

[list]
[*]Adds Pepper Rex as a barn animal ([b][i]not [/i][/b]a replacer!)
[*]No new items: Dinosaur Egg + Ostrich Incubator = Pepper Rex Barn Animal
[*]Uses vanilla game tokens to ensure compatibility with translations in-game (manual translations for config menu)
[*]Uses vanilla game sprites repositioned to create a compatible sprite sheet
[*]Identical incubation time and produce as Coop Dinosaurs
[/list]
[list]
[*]Configurable sell price for the animal, for if you feel the barn version should sell for more than the coop version
[/list][b]
[/b][list]
[*]You can now change the price of Dinosaur Eggs and Dinosaur Mayonnaise to your liking
[*]A toggle allows the buff from the Treasure Appraisal Guide to apply to Dinosaur Mayonnaise if you choose
[*]If you wish to disable the ability to incubate Dinosaur Eggs in the Coop, there is now a toggle for this
[*][i]Custom sprite for incubating dino egg :3[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added ability to change animal mature time (from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/173700366]ncarigon[/url])
[*]Added ability to change produce interval (from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/173700366]ncarigon[/url])
[/list]
[b][size=4]Animal Husbandry Compatability![/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New, optional content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross Mod Compatability Tokens[/url])
[*]Ability to set the type of meat dropped by the Pepper Rex
[*]Ability to set minimum and maximum number of meat dropped by Pepper Rex
[*]Ability to set the minimum number of days between treats
[*]Liked Treats: [spoiler]Cave Carrot, Fiddlehead Fern, Sturgeon, Ancient Fruit[/spoiler]
[*]Suggested balance values listed for the various options in their hover-text descriptions
[/list]
[b][u][size=3]Ncarigon suggested setup! (Base Game)[/size][/u][/b]
[spoiler]
"KeepCoop": "false",
"PriceAnimal": "20000",
"PriceEgg": "825",
"PriceMayo": "2100",
"DaysToMature": "9",
"DaysToProduce": "9",
"MayoBook": "false"
[/spoiler]

[b][u][size=3]Suggested Setup for Animal Husbandry![/size][/u][/b]
[spoiler]
"KeepCoop": "true",
"PriceAnimal": "10000",
"PriceEgg": "350",
"PriceMayo": "1050",
"DaysToMature": "7",
"DaysToProduce": "7",
"MayoBook": "false",
"Meat": "Pork",
"Minimum": "3",
"Maximum": "11",
"Treat": "4"
[/spoiler]

-Ability to manually set minimum and maximum amount of meat
-Ability to manually set days between treats
